features.title: What the jersey maker does
features.lead: Everything a custom jersey creator should do, in the browser, without a designer on your side.
items: Real-time 3D
Rotate the jersey as you build it. What you see is the sublimation file we print — no surprises at the mockup stage.
Colors without limits
Every panel, trim and stripe takes any color. Gradients, patterns and fades cost nothing extra — it's all one print.
Crest & sponsor upload
Upload your club crest and sponsor logos in the tool. A designer cleans and print-preps every logo before production.
Names & numbers
Add the full roster with per-player names, numbers and sizes on the cart. Included in the price.
Two sports, one maker
The same designer builds soccer jerseys, shorts and full kits, and basketball jerseys with the matching shorts. Switch sport, keep your artwork.
Order from the tool
No quote, no email chain. Set quantities, check the price ladder and check out. A production mockup follows in 24–48 h.

synonyms.title: Jersey maker, creator, designer, customizer — one tool
synonyms.body: People search for a jersey creator, a custom jersey maker, a jersey designer, a jersey configurator or a jersey generator. They mean the same thing: a tool that turns an idea into a real, wearable jersey. MOMUTO's version is the 3D designer — free to use, real-time, and wired straight to production, so the design you approve is the design that ships. It covers soccer (design your own soccer jersey) and basketball (custom basketball jerseys). If you would rather not build it yourself, the same team that runs the tool will design it for you: first mockup in 24–48 hours.

faq.title: Jersey maker FAQ
items: Is the jersey maker really free?
Yes. Designing in the 3D tool is free and needs no account. You pay only when you place an order, and the price is the ladder above — no setup, art or screen fees.
Which sports does the jersey maker cover?
Soccer and basketball today: soccer jerseys, shorts, socks and full kits, and basketball jerseys with matching shorts. Both use the same 3D designer and the same price ladder.
Can I make a single jersey?
Yes. There is no minimum order. A single jersey is $45.90; the per-jersey price falls to $25.90 at 10 and $19.90 at 100.
Can I upload my own logo and sponsor?
Yes. Upload PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF artwork in the maker. A designer cleans every crest and sponsor before production and sends you the file for approval.
Does the maker handle names and numbers?
Yes. Add the roster on the cart with each player's name, number and size. Names and numbers are included in the price; long sleeves are +$3 per player on soccer jerseys.
Can I use an AI-generated jersey design?
Yes. Send a ChatGPT, Midjourney or Gemini concept through the AI concept page and a designer rebuilds it as a print-ready jersey.
What if I don't like the result?

You approve a production mockup before anything prints, with unlimited revisions. If a jersey arrives defective or different from the approved mockup, we reprint or refund it — see the returns policy.
How long does a custom jersey take?
Mockup in 24–48 hours, 7–12 days production, 10–15 days shipping: plan on 25–30 days door to door. The fast lane (+$69) saves about a week.

cta.p: Open the free jersey maker and have a finished design in ten minutes — or send us your idea and let a designer build it.
